project.name: Cordit
project.tagline: Public stranger chat + voice with live observer mode, music sharing, and dynamic wallpaper glassmorphism
project.main_branch_status: green — fully synchronized with security hardening and passing CI suite
project.branch_scope_note: The active branch feature/public-stranger-chat serves as the release hardening vehicle encompassing public stranger matchmaking, observer governance, security gates, CI pipelines, and rate limiting.

production_launch_gate_criteria.policy: HARD BLOCKER — Public registration, external marketing, and un-gated DNS traffic are strictly restricted to staging/sandbox until 100% of the following critical safety and infrastructure gates pass automated verification.

gate_governance.deploy_gate_policy: A red or failing status on .github/workflows/security-ci.yml on branch main immediately halts all container build and deployment pipelines. No binary or Docker container is built or promoted until all checks are green.
gate_governance.event_driven_triggers: Any pull request or commit modifying security-critical files (backend/src/utils/socket.ts, backend/src/validators/*, backend/src/routes/upload.ts, backend/src/services/matchingService.ts, frontend/app/register/page.tsx) automatically triggers the security CI pipeline and requires fresh verification before merge.
gate_governance.graduation_criteria: A gate only transitions from INTERIM_MITIGATION_ACTIVE or BLOCKED to PASSED when production code is merged to main, integration tests pass in .github/workflows/security-ci.yml, and formal sign-off is tagged in git.

gate_checklist.requirement: Automated perceptual hashing (PDQ/PhotoDNA) on media upload pipelines with automated NCMEC referral triggers.
gate_checklist.interim_mitigation: Binary media uploads in stranger chat are hard-locked on both frontend and backend (POST /upload/request returns 403 Forbidden). Non-admin stranger rooms are text and WebRTC audio only.

graduation_roadmap.exit_criteria: Integration of pdq-wasm or cloud PhotoDNA API with automated test suite asserting positive rejection of standard test hashes.

gate_checklist.requirement: 18+ Age verification gate and explicit live broadcast terms consent acknowledgment.

verification.method: Automated CI Test Suite & Form Validation

gate_checklist.requirement: Rate limiting across both HTTP endpoints and WebSocket suggestion events (max 1 suggestion / 30s).

verification.method: Automated CI Test Suite & Live Socket Assertion
verification.result: PASSED (rapid second suggestion blocked with accurate cooldown timer)

gate_checklist.requirement: Rolling in-memory 30s audio buffer with on-demand encrypted transcription via Whisper for reported sessions.
gate_checklist.interim_mitigation: Voice channels restricted to mutual direct ID calls. Public registration restricted via invite codes (INVITE_ONLY=true).

graduation_roadmap.exit_criteria: LiveKit Egress worker deployed alongside Whisper API integration with automated synthetic audio speech-to-text benchmark.

verification.method: Planned LiveKit Egress Worker Integration Test

gate_checklist.requirement: Migration of matching pool from single-node memory to Redis Streams with consumer group ACK persistence.
gate_checklist.interim_mitigation: Single-node dev process. Concurrency capped at 50 simultaneous matches in local testbed.

graduation_roadmap.exit_criteria: Redis 7.x Streams deployment with automated chaos test script asserting zero lost matches (100% matched or cleanly re-queued), zero duplicate rooms, and DLQ depth <= 3 under 100 concurrent matching attempts with 20% random worker SIGKILL injection.

redis_streams_matching_and_idempotency.why_not_pub_sub: Redis Pub/Sub is fire-and-forget. If a worker crashes mid-handshake, the match event is permanently dropped.

reclaim_window_and_dead_letter_queue.min_idle_time: 12000 ms (12 seconds) tuned to P99.9 mobile network latency and connection jitter.
reclaim_window_and_dead_letter_queue.bounded_retries: Consumer group inspects delivery_count metadata. If delivery_count > 3, the message is automatically routed to a Dead Letter Queue (stream:matching:dlq) and acknowledged with XACK to prevent poison-pill infinite reclaim loops.

dlq_remediation_and_user_recovery.normal_remediation: When an item enters the DLQ, an automated worker unlocks both user state locks (DEL user:state:uA, DEL user:state:uB) and emits a socket event (matching:timeout_retry) to gracefully re-enqueue both users into the pool with fresh queue timestamps.
dlq_remediation_and_user_recovery.poison_client_loop_guard: Each re-enqueue increments a tracking key in Redis (INCR user:match_retries:<publicId> EX 600). If user:match_retries > 3 within a 10-minute window, automatic re-enqueue is aborted, the user lock is cleared, and the client receives a terminal socket notification: 'Matching handshake failed repeatedly. Please check your network connection and try again later.' This caps DLQ churn at 3 attempts per client.

reclaim_window_and_dead_letter_queue.dlq_monitoring_and_alerting: Prometheus metric cordit_matching_dlq_depth scraped every 15s. Alertmanager triggers a critical notification to Discord/Slack if DLQ depth > 0 for > 5 minutes.

idempotency_and_double_match_prevention: Deterministic Idempotency Key: lock:match:hash(min(uA,uB), max(uA,uB), epoch_slot_30s) acquired via SET ... NX EX 30.

Same-Pair Rematch Policy: Intentional rematches between the identical pair within the 30-second epoch slot are rejected with a 30s cooldown message ('Please wait 30s before re-pairing with the same stranger') to prevent griefing and queue-bouncing.

Atomic User State Locks: Lua script validates SET user:state:uA 'in_room' NX EX 60 and SET user:state:uB 'in_room' NX EX 60. If either user is already active elsewhere, the claim is acknowledged via XACK and discarded.

envelope_encryption_architecture: Ephemeral Session Key (K_room): A cryptographically random 256-bit key is generated per room via CSPRNG.
Buffer Encryption: In-memory 30-second rolling audio chunks are encrypted using AES-256-GCM with unique 96-bit nonces.
Key Custody & KMS: K_room is immediately wrapped with an asymmetric Master Moderation Key (K_master) managed in AWS KMS / GCP Cloud KMS (Enc_Kmaster(K_room)).
RAM Zeroization: Unreported chunks and K_room are wiped from RAM every 30 seconds via crypto.randomFillSync.
Audit Trail in Court: Only authenticated Compliance Officers with KMS kms:Decrypt IAM credentials can unwrap K_room.
voice_buffer_encryption_and_decoupled_sl.kms_outage_fallback: If AWS/GCP KMS experiences an outage during forensic decryption, Tier-1 automated containment remains 100% active. The raw encrypted audio buffer and wrapped key payload are safely committed to cold storage with a deferred decryption flag (DEFERRED_DECRYPT_KMS_OUTAGE). A scheduled worker cron job scans for DEFERRED_DECRYPT_KMS_OUTAGE records every 15 minutes, verifies KMS health check passes, unwraps keys, triggers Whisper transcription, and clears the deferred status.

tier_1_immediate_containment.action: Immediate socket freeze, audio track unpublish, and room quarantine upon report trigger. Operates instantly with zero dependency on KMS unwrap or Whisper transcription.

tier_2_forensic_decryption.action: Asynchronous KMS unwrap (15-30ms latency) and Whisper audio transcription (~15s processing for a 30s Opus chunk) producing timestamped forensic transcripts.

tier_3_regulatory_export.action: Packaging of decrypted audio, text transcripts, and IP hash for transmission to the NCMEC CyberTipline and legal authorities.

voice_buffer_encryption_and_decoupled_sl.sizing_math: Opus speech at 24 kbps (~3 KB/s) * 30s = 90 KB per participant. 1,000 active 2-person rooms (2,000 streams) = 180 MB RAM total. Modern CPU AES-NI instructions encrypt 90 KB in < 2 microseconds.

trust_weighted_abuse_velocity: Report Weight (W_user): Accounts < 24h old or with < 5 historical chats have W = 0.25 (requiring >= 12 novice reports to trigger quarantine).
Established Accounts: Users >= 30d with zero strikes have W = 1.0 (threshold = 3.0 weighted points in 60s).

Temporal Sybil Clustering: Reports arriving from the same subnet or within < 2 seconds of each other are flagged as Sybil clusters and routed to silent manual review without interrupting active participants.

hard_platform_limits.desktop_chromium: Full support (Google Chrome, MS Edge, Brave) via getDisplayMedia({ audio: true }).
hard_platform_limits.desktop_firefox: Partial support (requires system audio capture permission).
hard_platform_limits.desktop_safari: Unsupported (Apple WebKit sandbox blocks tab audio loopback).
hard_platform_limits.mobile_browsers: Strictly unsupported on all iOS and Android browsers.

tab_audio_platform_constraints.ui_degradation_strategy: The 'Share Tab Music' button detects userAgent and capability. On unsupported platforms, the button is cleanly disabled with tooltip: 'Tab audio sharing is only supported on Desktop Chrome/Edge'.

metrics: cordit_reports_total{reason, severity}: Counter tracking filed abuse reports
cordit_matching_dlq_depth: Gauge tracking dead-letter queue count
cordit_voice_seconds_total: Counter tracking WebRTC egress duration

compliance_and_data_retention_schedule.legal_basis: GDPR Article 6(1)(f) (Legitimate Interest for crime prevention, child safety, and legal defense).

retention_rules.disposition: Permanently wiped from in-memory ring buffers upon rolling expiration.

legal_hold_override.policy: If flagged for law enforcement subpoena, NCMEC referral, or active criminal investigation, an immutable S3 Object Lock (Legal Hold) indefinitely freezes the automated purge.
legal_hold_override.release_path: Legal holds can only be removed by authenticated Compliance Officers via a dedicated IAM role requiring multi-factor authentication (s3:PutObjectLegalHold with legal_hold=OFF). Every release event is immutably logged to AWS CloudTrail with mandatory docket reference numbers.

retention_rules.disposition: Stored in cold encrypted cloud storage with restricted IAM access, automatically purged after 90 days via S3 Lifecycle rule unless legal hold is active.

retention_rules.retention_period: Duration of active account, wiped within 72h of Right to Erasure request (/api/user/delete).

single_dev_capacity_and_scope_reduction_.reality: A solo developer cannot simultaneously maintain a distributed WebRTC mesh, complex media pipelines, and 24/7 manual moderation.
cut_scope_and_freezes: Music Tab Sharing is frozen as an experimental desktop-only toy with zero support commitments.
Binary media uploads in stranger chat are disabled until GATE-01 hash checking clears.
Multi-channel room creation and DMs are deprioritized until safety gates pass.
